provenance.source: 本地自建，非上游 AssetOpsBench fmsr MCP server
provenance.construction: 按 ASHRAE RP-1043 冷水机组 FDD 标准故障分类（8 类）逐条重建；测点归因按制冷循环物理（过热度/过冷度/传热系数/比功率）推导，写库时不再参考场景提问措辞，也不写入'某题问什么就写什么'的条目
provenance.known_residual_bias: 作者已读过 18 条 FMSR 场景，无法真正'遗忘'；仍保留的是故障名的通用英文写法和本机 12 个测点的真实名称，其余字段（描述、时序签名、监测方案、优先级）均为物理重写
provenance.compare_to: v1 = fmsr_chillers.json（12 个故障模式，按 18 条提问需求重建）
provenance.不可声称: 不得称本知识库等同上游 fmsr server；v2 的价值只在于给出一个'不按题目定制'的对照点

temperature: Condenser Water Return To Tower Temperature

failure_modes.name: Condenser Fouling
failure_modes.description: Scale or biofilm on the condenser water side raises the condenser approach temperature, so the same heat rejection needs a higher condensing pressure and more compressor work.
detected_by: Condenser Water Return To Tower Temperature
temporal: condenser approach rises slowly over weeks
specific power (Power Input / Tonnage) drifts up
effect is strongest at high load
monitoring_plan: trend condenser approach against design value
track kW/ton at comparable load and wet-bulb
schedule tube cleaning when approach exceeds the threshold
failure_modes.priority_sensor: Condenser Water Return To Tower Temperature

failure_modes.name: Reduced Condenser Water Flow
failure_modes.description: A throttled valve, clogged strainer or failing pump lowers condenser water flow, which raises the leaving condenser water temperature and degrades heat rejection.
detected_by: Condenser Water Return To Tower Temperature
temporal: flow drops as a step or ramp, not a slow drift
condenser water temperature difference widens
trip risk appears once flow falls below the minimum
monitoring_plan: compare flow with pump curve and design flow
check strainer differential pressure
verify valve position against command

failure_modes.name: Non-condensable Gases in Refrigerant
failure_modes.description: Air or nitrogen entering the refrigerant circuit accumulates in the condenser and raises condensing pressure without a matching load increase.
detected_by: Condenser Water Return To Tower Temperature
temporal: condensing pressure high while evaporator temperature stays normal
efficiency loss is load independent
purge activity or run time increases
monitoring_plan: compare measured condensing pressure with the saturation value implied by condenser water temperature
log purge counts
recover refrigerant and evacuate when confirmed

failure_modes.name: Reduced Evaporator Water Flow
failure_modes.description: Restricted chilled-water flow lowers the evaporator heat transfer coefficient, so the supply temperature rises and capacity falls for the same load.
temporal: chilled-water temperature difference widens
supply temperature drifts toward the return temperature
low-evaporator-temperature or freeze protection trips appear
monitoring_plan: trend delta-T at constant load
check secondary loop valve position and pump status
verify evaporator pressure drop

failure_modes.name: Refrigerant Undercharge
failure_modes.description: A leak reduces refrigerant charge, lowering evaporator pressure and subcooling so the compressor must run longer to hold the setpoint.
temporal: evaporator temperature rises above the design saturation value
subcooling shrinks and may disappear
capacity loss grows gradually as charge escapes
monitoring_plan: trend subcooling and evaporator approach
leak test the circuit at the joints and seals
recharge to the nameplate weight, not by pressure alone

failure_modes.name: Refrigerant Overcharge
failure_modes.description: Excess charge floods condenser tubes, raising condensing pressure and subcooling and reducing available heat-transfer area.
temporal: subcooling stays high after the load stabilises
condensing pressure rises with a stable load
efficiency falls while capacity barely changes
monitoring_plan: compare subcooling with the design band
verify charge against the as-built weight
recover excess charge rather than venting

failure_modes.name: Excess Oil in Refrigerant
failure_modes.description: Oil migrating into the evaporator coats tube surfaces, adding a thermal resistance that shows up as a capacity loss with unchanged water flow.
temporal: capacity falls while flow and temperatures stay nominal
efficiency loss does not respond to cleaning the water side
oil level in the sump drops over time
monitoring_plan: compare measured capacity with the water-side heat balance
check oil return orifice and eductor
oil-return test then recharge oil to the correct level

failure_modes.name: Evaporator Fouling
failure_modes.description: Fouling on the evaporator water side adds resistance, so the approach temperature rises and the supply temperature cannot reach the setpoint at full load.
temporal: evaporator approach rises over weeks to months
setpoint becomes unreachable at design load
effect scales with load, unlike a charge fault
monitoring_plan: trend evaporator approach at comparable load
inspect brushes and water quality records
clean tubes and re-baseline the approach

symptom_causes.note: flow itself is the causal variable; check strainer and valve before suspecting tubes

symptom_causes.sensor: Condenser Water Return To Tower Temperature
symptom_causes.note: approach rise at stable flow and load points to tube-side resistance

symptom_causes.sensor: Condenser Water Return To Tower Temperature
symptom_causes.note: distinguish by purge activity and by load independence of the efficiency loss
efficiency is a lagging indicator; confirm with condenser approach before acting
if water-side cleaning does not restore efficiency, suspect oil in the evaporator
widening chilled-water delta-T separates flow restriction from fouling
approach rise with normal flow favours fouling over flow restriction
rising evaporator temperature with shrinking subcooling is the charge signature
high subcooling at stable load supports overcharge
capacity loss with nominal water flow and no charge anomaly
